claims.claim_text: At approximately 1045 hours, while conducting a routine patrol of the La Quinta Inn parking lot at 1515 South Coast Drive, I observed an occupied gray 2006 Ford Focus in a marked stall facing north.
The subject appeared to be slumped over the steering wheel.
I engaged the subject in conversation for approximately five minutes, during which time Officer Fuentes contacted the passengers.
During this conversation, the subject was cooperative and kept his hands visible on the steering wheel as instructed.
I noted that his left hand appeared to have a bandage on it.
Immediately after W-1 was removed from the vehicle, the subject started the engine and placed the vehicle in reverse.
The vehicle reversed at a moderate speed, and the rear bumper made brief contact with the front of our patrol vehicle.
W-2, who was positioned approximately ten feet from the vehicle's path, was not struck during this movement.
I fired a total of five rounds toward the vehicle. Officer Fuentes fired approximately five rounds as well.
The encounter from the time the subject started the vehicle until shots were fired lasted approximately forty-five seconds.
The vehicle traveled forward an estimated thirty feet before coming to rest.
Paramedics from Costa Mesa Fire Department arrived approximately twenty minutes later and transported the subject to Orange County Global Medical Center.
A subsequent search of the subject's person did not locate any weapons. The vehicle was processed and no firearms were recovered from inside.
We removed the subject from the vehicle and began CPR.
W-2 released at scene without injury.
